reading.label: For Luther, unbelief does not unmake the instituted sacrament
reading.text: Its identity rests on Christ’s words rather than the guest’s virtue. Saving benefit still requires faith; validity is not a promise that every guest benefits.
reading.attribution: Attributed paraphrase — Luther, Large Catechism, Part V, §§16–18 and 33–37 (1529), Bente/Dau 1921 translation. Sacramental identity and benefit received through faith are distinguished.
